text:
elena: Hey — after our Okta rollout I lost access to project 'zephyr' in the console. Getting a 403 when opening settings. Tried incognito and clearing cookies.
matt: Adding support. Can you paste the exact error (or a curl) and your email so we can look it up?
elena: curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' https://console.redwood.ai/api/projects/zephyr/settings
--- response ---
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{ "error": "permission_denied", "reason": "missing_project_role" }
sre-bot: audit: SCIM sync for org acme-corp failed at 2026-03-12T12:14:05Z — group-to-role mapping mismatch detected
irina: Okta identity team here — we deployed a claim rename yesterday (`roles` -> `role_claims`). SCIM and our group mappings were not updated for some customers, so the console may not see the expected role claim.
matt: That matches what I'm seeing. Likely cause: id_token now carries `role_claims` but console mapping expects `roles`. Two quick options: 1) invite the user directly to the project (manual fix) or 2) run a SCIM resync to reconcile groups. Which do you prefer?
elena: We can't add invites because we don't have org owner access. We're blocked on a deploy — would appreciate a resync + quick check.
sam: I can run a forced resync. Repro (what I'll run): 1) trigger SCIM resync for org acme-corp 2) verify group->project-role mappings 3) check audit log for updated memberships
matt: If you can share a minimal set of id_token claims (redact sub/iss), that helps confirm mapping. Example we need: `role_claims` or group names.
elena: minimal claims: { "email": "elena@acme.com", "role_claims": ["project:zephyr:admin"] } — but console shows no roles for my user.
sam: Starting resync now: `internal-cli scim resync --org acme-corp --force` (job id r-88). ETA ~45s.
sre-bot: Resync job r-88 started by sam at 2026-03-12T12:20:01Z
sre-bot: Resync job r-88 completed at 2026-03-12T12:20:37Z — 1 mapping updated, 3 members reattached, no errors
matt: Can you try opening the project settings again?
elena: Confirmed — I can open settings and make changes. No more 403. :tada:
irina: We'll push an update to our SCIM mapping docs and add a guard to handle `role_claims` aliasing so claim renames are tolerated in future. Apologies for the disruption.
elena: Thanks everyone — will close the ticket. :thumbsup:
